page: Microsoft Azure EC64ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. The configuration provides 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 32 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The memory subsystem delivers 512 GB of RAM, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. Integrated instruction set extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI and bfloat16 support, alongside accelerated cryptographic instruction sets such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Local ephemeral capacity is provided by a bundled 2577 GB solid-state drive, complemented by support for remote Premium Storage volumes. In synthetic benchmarks, the instance demonstrates upper-quartile execution capabilities, posting a stress-ng single-core score of 3023.56 and a multi-core score of 96142.57. Memory and caching operations exhibit robust throughput under write pressure, logging 80.06 million operations per second in Redis SET workload testing.

From an architectural standpoint, the combination of a high memory-to-core ratio and direct-attached NVMe-class storage optimizes data-intensive execution by lowering the latency of scratch operations. Tradeoffs include the absence of dedicated GPU acceleration and the ephemeral lifecycle of the integrated local SSD, which requires deliberate persistence design for stateful applications.

Microsoft Azure EC64ads_v6 fits large in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, real-time analytics engines, and enterprise enterprise resource planning (ERP) workloads requiring substantial physical memory and dense CPU concurrency.

The hardware profile includes 2577 GB of local solid-state storage and support for Premium Storage tiers, coupled with hardware vector extensions including AVX-512. Benchmark results reflect upper-quartile processing capacity, achieving 96142.57 on stress-ng multi-core tests and 80.06 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations. The instance lacks specialized GPU acceleration, focusing resource efficiency instead on high memory density and rapid local scratch storage. Microsoft Azure EC64ads_v6 is suited for in-memory databases, large-scale caching, transaction processing, and memory-intensive analytics workloads.
